name: ai-native-stlc
description: AI Native STLC: Claude does a software tester's routine work, and the tester makes every decision.

plugins.name: ai-native-stlc
plugins.description:
The complete QA lifecycle with Claude, from requirements to release. You approve every decision.
- 13 commands for each stage: requirements, test plan, test cases, test runs, bug reports, user manual, release report. Start with /ai-native-stlc:qa
- 8 skills: QA know-how
- 2 agents: QA assistant, read-only reviewer
- Safety checks: your test sites only, no personal data, no unapproved bugs
- Word and Excel output, English or Arabic
Needs Node.js. Works in Cowork and Claude Code.
